'''D'randq''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] who was a member of the [[Believers]] during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
In c. [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], D'randq became part of a group of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] at the [[Almas Sith fortress]] who served [[Garvin Delquist]], a researcher who had gained control of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] from a [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulet]]. D'randq served as one of Delquist's bodyguards. After Delquist had the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Misha Quor-Din]] captured and taken to the fortress, the [[Heroes of Cularin]] traveled there to rescue her and D'randq and Delquist's other bodyguards fought against them.
